name: Stuffed
source:
You're just an ordinary student living with your grandma, with a totally healthy obsession for collecting plush toys of all kinds.

All of a sudden....two of your very own dolls have COME TO LIFE!

One of them is violently ecstatic to have your undivided attention!

And the other comes with a list of demands, to make up for all your years of neglectful ownership!

Once you learn more about them, you discover that they're (probably) harmless.

But why do you get the feeling they're hiding something sinister underneath the stuffing...

[From [url=https://runozart.itch.io/stuffed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你只是一个和奶奶住在一起的普通学生，对收集各种毛绒玩具有着完全健康的痴迷。

突然间…你自己的两个娃娃活了！

其中一位因得到你的全神贯注而欣喜若狂！

另一个则附有一份要求清单，以弥补你多年来忽视的所有权！

一旦你对它们有了更多了解，你就会发现它们（可能）是无害的。

但为什么你感觉他们在馅料下面藏着一些邪恶的东西……

[来自[url=https://runozart.itch.io/stuffed]itch.io[/url]]
